subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: Should shared/private dashboard tabs be implemented as bundled dashboard work, and what security boundary should tab `visibility` or `scope` promise?
rationale: The request crosses Control UI display, Gateway operator scopes, privacy expectations, and persistent dashboard state, so automation cannot decide whether this is convenience filtering or an authorization boundary.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Subissue
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Wave 1 dashboard base is settled, then require store enforcement, migration handling, and security proof for tab visibility.

options.title: Fold Into The Tracker
options.body: Close this only if maintainers want the Wave 2+ roadmap tracker to own all Tier 3 dashboard planning without separate subissues.

options.title: Move Outside Bundled Work
options.body: Defer bundled implementation and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package if maintainers do not want multi-user dashboard semantics in core-distributed surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Subissue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the Wave 1 dashboard base is settled, then require store enforcement, migration handling, and security proof for tab visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recently merged plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that this dashboard stack builds on.
